mechanism: Guanfacine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, and propafenone is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase guanfacine concentrations; additionally, both agents have cardiovascular effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider dose reduction of guanfacine if signs of excessive hypotension or bradycardia develop; ECG monitoring may be warranted.
